name: LINTEC Corporation
summary: LINTEC Corporation engages in the manufacture and sale of adhesive-related products in Japan. The company offers printing and variable information-related products, including adhesive papers and films for seals and labels, barcode label supplies, and digital label printing machines; industrial and automobile use adhesive products, barcode printers, and labeling machines for commercial and industrial use; and construction related products comprising window and automotive films, large sized printing related products, marking films, and interior finishing mounting sheets.
